device.basis: X-T3 5.11 audio format converter at 0xfffa8000. Its driver clears +0x00 bit 0 and waits for it to read set (0x1091110); to load a conversion table it writes the table to +0x0c/+0x10, clears +0x08 bit 0, sets +0x04 bit 0 and waits for that bit to read clear (0x1091150). The converter's job interrupt is job 0x71, GIC 144, in the job table at 0x13e6454. +0x00 bit 0 reads set; setting +0x04 bit 0 starts a job that clears the bit and pulses 144 after 5400 ticks (100 us, declared, not measured). No samples are converted: that is the audio_converter option of emulator-xp4-board, left off here.
